tools.accounts_get: medium|Read account metadata; explicit account required by deployment policy.
tools.dns_records_create: high|Create a single DNS record, affecting traffic or domain verification.
tools.dns_records_delete: critical|Delete a single DNS record by explicit zone and record ID; verify record identity before approval.
tools.dns_records_edit: high|PATCH a DNS record; omitted fields may retain existing values.
tools.dns_records_get: medium|Read a single DNS record; content may include sensitive verification values.
tools.dns_records_list: medium|Read records in an explicit zone; query filters and pagination affect visibility.
tools.dns_records_update: high|PUT a DNS record; review full replacement rather than assuming PATCH semantics.
tools.pages_create: high|Create a Pages project; build commands, source integration and deployment configuration can enable executable automation.
tools.pages_delete: critical|Delete a project and its deployments.
tools.pages_deployments_create: high|Create a Git-branch or direct-manifest deployment; branch uses HEAD, not necessarily commit_hash as a pinned revision. Body may contain executable Worker content.
tools.pages_deployments_delete: critical|Delete a deployment, potentially affecting available rollback targets.
tools.pages_deployments_get: medium|Read deployment status/configuration; results may contain project environment metadata.
tools.pages_deployments_list: medium|Read deployment history and configuration metadata.
tools.pages_deployments_retry: high|Retry a deployment; executes build/deploy automation again.
tools.pages_deployments_rollback: high|Change production to a previous deployment.
tools.pages_domains_create: high|Attach a custom hostname to a Pages project.
tools.pages_domains_delete: critical|Remove a custom hostname from a Pages project.
tools.pages_domains_get: medium|Read domain configuration and validation status.
tools.pages_domains_list: medium|List custom domains for an explicit project.
tools.pages_domains_validation_retry: high|Retry domain validation; an operational action, not a pure getter.
tools.pages_edit: high|Change build/source/deployment settings; setting an environment variable key to null deletes it.
tools.pages_get: medium|Read project configuration; environment values may be sensitive, so retain governance.
tools.pages_list: medium|List projects and configuration in an explicit account; retain governance for sensitive metadata.
tools.pages_source_connect: high|Connect a preauthorized Git provider repository and configure automatic deployments and PR comments.
tools.pages_source_disconnect: high|Disconnect the repository and stop Git-based deployment integration.
tools.zones_get: medium|Read metadata of an explicit zone. Zone creation, deletion and global settings are excluded.
